subject: Reconciliation timeline for annual prepay + escrow onboarding
messages:
From: Anika Singh <anika.singh@brightlinecloud.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@brightlinecloud.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Discrepancy on annual prepay application + VAT hold on EU invoices

Hi Lauren,

Hope youre well. Quick one from our side: we kicked off our annual prepay (committed spend) of USD 240,000 on May 1 and our accounting team shows only USD 220,000 applied to our Redwood ledger to date. The attached "Brightline_Invoice_May2027.pdf" is the invoice we received; our AP team is holding a subset of EU invoices pending VAT evidence which may explain some delays, but the 20k gap still looks odd.

Can you confirm:
- How drawdowns are being applied to the committed balance (monthly automated vs manual pulls)?
- Whether any credit memos or internal adjustments were issued in June that we should expect?
- A realistic timeline to reconcile the 20k gap and get the EU VAT evidence squared so we can clear the hold?

Wed like to avoid a manual month-end adjustment if possible. If you can give us a reconciliation ETA and any required action items on our side (PO, wiring confirmation, VAT forms), well prioritize it.

Thanks,
Anika Singh
Director, Finance 
Brightline Cloud
(finance@brightlinecloud.com)

Attachment: Brightline_Invoice_May2027.pdf (pdf)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Anika Singh <anika.singh@brightlinecloud.com>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on annual prepay application + VAT hold on EU invoices

Hi Anika thanks for flagging this and for attaching the invoice. Short answer: well run a full ledger pull and reconciliation, and we can also stand up an escrow-backed drawdown schedule to avoid future manual holds while VAT is being processed. Action plan proposal below: 

1) Immediate ledger reconciliation (T+7): Redwood finance (Markus + Irene) will run a transaction-level export and reconcile all drawdowns/credits with the Brightline billing account. Expected completion: July 6.
2) VAT evidence handoff (T+10): Well list the specific VAT forms we need from your side for EU invoices; our billing ops will clear holds as documents arrive.
3) Escrow onboarding to cover committed amount (optional but recommended): If Brightline signs the escrow agreement we can enable an automated monthly drawdown flow that doesnt rely on AP approvals for each invoice. Draft escrow agreement attached for your legal review.
4) Final reconciliation & statement (T+12): Consolidated account statement and short notes on any credit memos or internal adjustments.

Please see attached "redwood_recon_template.xlsx"; if you can drop in your PO number and any ledger references well use that to match faster. If youd like, I can schedule a 30-minute call this week with Markus and Irene to walk through the ledger detail.

Proposed dates (if this works for you):
- Reconciliation complete: July 6
- Escrow agreement signed (if proceeding): target July 20
- Automated monthly drawdown live: August 1

Let me know which path you prefer (standard reconciliation vs. escrow + automated draws) and well prioritize.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0184

Attachments: redwood_recon_template.xlsx (xlsx), escrow_agreement_draft.pdf (pdf)

Markus / Irene,

Looping you in to execute the reconciliation and escalate if there are missing credit memos. Key details: Brightline (RDW-2027-174B) reports USD 240k committed; our ledger shows USD 220k applied. They have an EU VAT hold on a subset of invoices (attachment).

Please action: 
- Markus: run transaction export for Brightline account (account id: BRG-4098), include all draws, credits, and refunds from May 1 -> Jun 30. Owner: Markus. Deadline: 2027-07-06 EOD.

Lauren
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Anika Singh <anika.singh@brightlinecloud.com>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on annual prepay application + VAT hold on EU invoices 

Hi Anika,

Quick update after our internal review: we completed the ledger pull and matched transactions. Summary: 
- Total committed: USD 240,000
- Applied drawdowns (posted): USD 220,000
- Outstanding hold / timing difference: USD 20,000 (primarily due to 3 EU invoices held by Brightline AP pending VAT confirmation; no internal credit memos were posted on Redwood's side)

Next steps we can execute immediately if you approve: 
1) If Brightline signs the attached escrow agreement, Redwood will enable automated monthly drawdowns of the committed balance starting 2027-08-01. That will remove per-invoice manual approvals for the portion held in escrow.
2) Our VAT checklist (attached) lists the exact fields your AP/legal should provide to clear the EU hold. Irene is available to work directly with your tax team.
3) We will provide a consolidated statement (CSV) reconciling all transactions and a short narrative of the 20k gap by July 9.

Please confirm the PO number and whether youd like to proceed with escrow onboarding (well target the week of July 19 for DocuSign execution and account switch). If you want the automated draws live by Aug 1 well need signed escrow + wiring/PO by July 16.

Thanks for the fast turnaround on this. Happy to jump on a 20-minute call if you prefer to walk through the ledger line-by-line.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0184
